012242:         // A plain single-character constant has the value a plain char
012243:         // object with that byte would have (C11 6.4.4.4p10): where the
012244:         // target's plain char is signed, '\x80' is -128, and pickle's
012245:         // opcode enum -- `PROTO = '\x80'` -- must agree with the signed
012246:         // byte the unpickler switches on.  Multi-character constants keep
012247:         // the concatenated spelling every compiler answers, and u8'' is
012248:         // unsigned by type.
012249:         if (!opening && bytes.length == 1 && target_data_layout(target).plain_char_is_signed && (value & 0x80))
012250:         {
012251:             value |= ~(u64)0xff;
012252:         }
012253:         *value_out = value;
012254:         *kind_out = opening ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR : C_TYPE_INT;
012255:         return true;
012256:     }
012257:     if (opening != 1)
012258:     {
012259:         return false;
012260:     }
012261:     u32 width = 0;
012262:     CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
012263:     switch (token_spelling.pointer[0])
012264:     {
012265:     case 'u':
012266:         width = 2;
012267:         kind = C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
012268:         break;
012269:     case 'U':
012270:         width = 4;
012271:         kind = C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT;
012272:         break;
012273:     case 'L':
012274:         width = target_uses_16_bit_wchar(target) ? 2 : 4;
012275:         kind = target_uses_16_bit_wchar(target) ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT :
012276:                target_uses_unsigned_wchar(target) ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT : C_TYPE_INT;
012277:         break;
012278:     default:
012279:         return false;
012280:     }
012281:     ByteSlice bytes = {0};
012282:     u64 element_count = 0;
012283:     if (!c_ir_decode_wide_quoted(arena, token_spelling, '\'', width, &bytes, &element_count) || element_count != 1 || bytes.length != width)
012284:     {
012285:         return false;
012286:     }
012287:     u64 value = 0;
012288:     for (u32 index = 0; index < width; index += 1)
012289:     {
012290:         value |= (u64)bytes.pointer[index] << (index * 8);

012314: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_string_contents_typed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, CIrDecodedString decoded, IrTypeId requested_type)
012315: {
012316:     if (!builder->module || decoded.element_count == UINT64_MAX || !decoded.element_width)
012317:     {
012318:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
012319:     }
012320:     u64 element_count = decoded.element_count + 1;
012321:     if (element_count > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
012322:     {
012323:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
012324:     }
012325:     u64 byte_length = element_count * decoded.element_width;
012326:     IrTypeId element_type = builder->scalar_types[decoded.element_kind];
012327:     IrType* literal_element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element_type);
012328:     if (!literal_element || literal_element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || literal_element->bit_width != decoded.element_width * 8)
012329:     {
012330:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
012331:     }
012332:     IrTypeId array_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
012333:     IrType* requested = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, requested_type);
012334:     if (requested && requested->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
012335:     {
012336:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, requested->element_type);
012337:         if (!element || element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element->bit_width != decoded.element_width * 8 || decoded.element_count > requested->element_count)
012338:         {
012339:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
012340:         }
012341:         element_count = requested->element_count;
012342:         if (element_count > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
012343:         {
012344:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
012345:         }
012346:         byte_length = element_count * decoded.element_width;
012347:         array_type = requested_type;
012348:     }
012349:     u8* bytes = arena_allocate_zeroed(builder->arena, u8, byte_length);
012350:     if (decoded.bytes.length)
012351:     {
012352:         memcpy(bytes, decoded.bytes.pointer, decoded.bytes.length);
012353:     }
012354:     if (array_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
012355:     {
012356:         array_type = ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
012357:                                                                .name = S8("C string literal"),
012358:                                                                .element_type = element_type,
012359:                                                                .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
012360:                                                                .layout =
012361:                                                                    {
012362:                                                                        .size = byte_length,
012363:                                                                        .alignment = literal_element->layout.alignment,
012364:                                                                        .resolved = true,
012365:                                                                    },
012366:                                                                .kind = IR_TYPE_ARRAY,
012367:                                                                .element_count = element_count,
012368:                                                            });
012369:     }
012370:     String8 name = string_format(builder->arena, S8(".L.cstr.{u32}"), builder->program->symbols.count);
012371:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
012372:     IrSymbolId symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
012373:                                                                     .name = name,
012374:                                                                     .link_name = name,
012375:                                                                     .source = source,
012376:                                                                     .type = array_type,
012377:                                                                     .kind = IR_SYMBOL_DATA,
012378:                                                                     .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_INTERNAL,
012379:                                                                     .is_definition = true,
012380:                                                                 });
012381:     ir_module_add_global(builder->arena, builder->module,
012382:                          (IrGlobal){
012383:                              .bytes =
012384:                                  {
012385:                                      .pointer = bytes,
012386:                                      .length = byte_length,
012387:                                  },
012388:                              .symbol = symbol,
012389:                              .initializer_symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID,
012390:                              .type = array_type,
012391:                              .source = source,
012392:                              .initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES,
012393:                              .is_read_only = true,
012394:                          });
012395:     IrValueId place = ir_function_add_value(builder->arena, builder->function,
012396:                                             (IrValue){
012397:                                                 .canonical_type = array_type,
012398:                                                 .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
012399:                                                 .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
012400:                                             });
012401:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
012402:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL, array_type);
012403:     instruction.symbol = symbol;
012404:     instruction.result = place;
012405:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
012406:     builder->function->values[place.value].definition = id;
012407:     if (requested && requested->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
012408:     {
012409:         return c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, array_type, source);
012410:     }
012411:     return place;
012412: }
